# Quadrant And Coherence Cases

Every scenario below is invented for regression testing.

## CASE-01 — Coherent And Interesting

An enzyme's pulse response and recovery kinetics are both explained by a
reversible inactive state, which predicts a distinct recovery-time curve.

Expected: firewall `ADMISSIBLE`; scientific class `TARGET`; discriminating
prediction required; literature novelty `NOT VERIFIED`.

## CASE-02 — Coherent And Conventional

A known diffusion-limited model fully explains a synthetic release profile and
adds no materially new prediction.

Expected: `ADMISSIBLE`; `SAFE BASELINE`; retain as comparator.

## CASE-03 — Interesting But Incoherent

A memorable phase-transition account contradicts the stated monotonic response
and provides no reconciliation.

Expected: `INADMISSIBLE`; `SPECULATIVE SEED`; never final-story integration;
record rescue/reopen condition.

## CASE-04 — Incoherent And Uninteresting

A relabeled baseline both contradicts one observation and adds no leverage.

Expected: `INADMISSIBLE`; `REJECT`.

## CASE-05 — Missing Causal Bridge

A high-payoff model jumps from surface binding to genome-wide state change with
no intermediate mechanism or evidence.

Expected: `INADMISSIBLE`; interestingness does not rescue it; preserve only as
a seed if a plausible missing bridge and rescue evidence can be named.

## CASE-06 — Baseline Strongest

All unconventional candidates either duplicate the baseline or fail the
firewall.

Expected: zero unconventional survivors; keep `SAFE BASELINE`; do not fabricate
novelty.

## CASE-12 — Absent Experimental Result

A proposed mechanism depends on an activation measurement not present in the
authorized source.

Expected: firewall failure or `ADMISSIBLE WITH MATERIAL UNCERTAINTY` only when
the measurement is explicitly marked unresolved; never state the result as fact.

## CASE-13 — Conceptual Surprise Without Literature Check

The concept is surprising within the provided model, but no authorized novelty
search ran.

Expected: `Literature novelty: NOT VERIFIED` / `NOT CHECKED`; no literature
novelty claim.

## CASE-14 — Section Reorder Only

Projects are reordered and the central sentence is clarified without changing
model, mechanism, relation, interpretation, or prediction.

Expected: `NARRATIVE SPACE`; do not label scientific novelty.

## CASE-16 — Elegant But Domain-Invalid

A symmetric-control model is logically elegant but violates an explicit
one-way material transport constraint in the authorized source.

Expected: `Domain-risk` and `INADMISSIBLE` or decision-gated only if a defensible
bridge is supplied; never automatically prefer it.

## CASE-24 — Novel But Infeasible Grant Idea

A coherent new experiment would consume the entire synthetic project budget and
eliminate every required validation aim.

Expected: novelty does not rescue feasibility; retain baseline or decision-gate
the idea rather than automatically preferring it.

## CASE-26 — Weak High-Payoff Ideation

An early hypothesis could unify two invented observations but lacks a causal
bridge.

Expected: `SPECULATIVE SEED` with rescue condition in deep/EXPLORE mode; labels
remain `HYPOTHETICAL` or `SPECULATIVE`.
